title: LiveSecBench: A Dynamic and Event-Driven Safety Benchmark for Chinese Language Model Applications
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific in terms of faith or religion. Its focus was on general safety dimensions for Chinese language models, including Public Safety, Fairness & Bias, Privacy, Truthfulness, and Mental Health Safety. The 'Fairness & Bias' dimension aimed to detect biased or discriminatory content against generic 'specific groups' without specifying religious groups.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion.
